design: Profile-blind fixed 50/50 latent per-opponent prior over closed-branch-control and min-hand-pips likelihoods; posterior marginalizes each profile across its last 3 observed tile-group choices. Oracle profile is reported ONLY as sensitivity benchmark. One public-pass-selected position/deal, same-tile different-end pair. Sample pass-compatible current hands deterministically; reconstruct earlier hands from public played tiles AFTER each observed choice, compute softmax likelihood of chosen tile GROUP (not branch label) under known synthetic opponent bot profile. Reweight identical worlds for both candidate next-pass labels. 10% uniform lapse, temperature=1, utility removedPips/3 + 6*mixedFinish - 4*openedDoubles for closed-branch-control. At most 3 most recent opponent play choices per opponent. Compare weighted MC against EXACT pass-only combinatorial posterior. Two disjoint seed halves.
limitations: Blind 50/50 prior and synthetic softmax choice likelihood are assumptions, not learned human policy. Oracle metric is diagnostic only;  choice likelihood is hypothetical, not the actual deterministic bot likelihood; importance sampling has finite-world variance and potentially low ESS; public selection enriched for informative passes; first eligible per deal; correlated two counterfactual actions; provisional branch number-lock and unresolved block winner/loneZero/bust/101. No human tactic inferred.
nextAction: Compare blind profile mixture against exact pass-only on independent seeds and non-certain holdout; validate sensitivity to opponent-policy mismatch, authentic branch and blocked winner.
